correctness.rationale: The standard virtual-localization graph formula was reconstructed from Graber-Pandharipande. For each degree-1 edge, their edge factor equals the reciprocal of the product of the two tangent Euler factors; combined with the stable central vertex and four flags this reduces to the package projective-space factor: reciprocal central Euler factor times reciprocal endpoint Euler factors times reciprocal negative edge weights, multiplied by the Mbar(0,4) integral J=(sum of reciprocal edge weights)/(product of edge weights). The quintic normalization sequence gives the product of the four edge Q-factors divided by the cube of 5 lambda_k. An independent exact Fraction recomputation over all ordered stars and division by 24 reproduces 14339846746454566537552143617879921875/1033947715493982426365952, not 589731482057/6.
